name: Cloud Dragon, riding (version B)
note: Version 2. One posed model: the cloud is one unbroken piece, like the drawing: it starts as his dragon afro, runs down behind his left shoulder, across behind his legs, becomes the cloud he stands on, and ends in a curled tail. Claude checked all three views against the drawing (one cloud, same crouch in every view, skin tone, hearts, belt, boots). From behind, the cloud drapes across his back.

name: Pink Puff
note: A static posed model of Pink Puff levitating on all fours: body level, arms reaching down with open clawed hands, knees bent with shins pointing back. The puffs he grabs are left out because the game draws them as particles. Checked every view against the 2D art and each other (same pose, caramel golden-brown skin, no loose pieces). Question for you: the two approved drawings disagree on his top (bare-chested front vs a fluffy pink top on the back drawing); these views follow the bare-chested front.

name: Centaur Bull
note: A static posed model of the Centaur Bull mid-gallop on his own four legs: his right front leg is tucked up and the other three hooves stand on one flat line, so the model has a level base. The glowing stars under his hooves are left out because the game draws them in code. His skin is a little deeper caramel than the 2D art because 3D textures come out lighter. The cheek star, star earring and haunch star sit on his left side, as in the front drawing (the back drawing puts the cheek star on the other side and gives him a cream belly; the model does not copy those). Four legs and the same raised leg checked in every view; the wings stay attached to the hoodie.

name: Rocket-Skate Rider
note: A young skater in a low racing crouch on her own orange-and-magenta rocket skates; the flames are left out because the game draws them in code. Built from the newer concept: oversized orange jacket with a magenta chest stripe, baggy tan cargo pants, bantu knots with orange ties. The concept only shows her from behind, so the front was made up: face looking ahead, a zipped jacket, small gold hoops, a rocket nozzle on each heel, and feet side by side so every view shows the same pose. Checked all three views against the concept and each other. Quincy asked for a different design for this rider (2026-11-04); it stays in critique until he says what should change.

name: Spirit-Beast Rider
note: Redone at Innocent's request: she now rides the golden spirit cheetah like a jockey, leaning over its shoulders with both hands on a gold collar and her boots tucked against its sides. The cheetah is a glowing gold-to-white spirit with swirling markings, glowing eyes and flame tips on its ears, tail and paws (loose sparks and light trails come from game code). Her look is unchanged. Claude's review: without its spots and the dark tear lines on its face, the beast reads more like a lioness than a cheetah; say if it should get cheetah tear lines and spirit-light spots back.

name: Cloud Rider
note: One posed model: the racer crouched on a solid, comet-shaped cloud board (fat at the front under his sneakers, tapering behind into a curled tail); the long wispy trail in the art is left for code. The art only shows him from behind, so the front is invented: he looks straight ahead, both arms spread evenly, and the board's shape is new. Question for you: he reads close to the Cloud Dragon (bare chest, cloud afro, heart pants, cloud ride). The dark storm afro, blue pants, sneakers and separate board tell them apart up close, but from the chase camera the two may look alike.

name: Wind-Ball Rider
note: One posed model of the girl crouching barefoot on top of her wind ball: a single solid sphere with a teal and white swirl painted on it, her feet touching its top in every view. The loose wind rings in the art are left out because the game draws them in code. The art only shows her from behind, so her face, the front of her cross-wrap top and the knotted sash on her left hip are invented. Known flaw: in the side view her arms sweep slightly backward instead of straight out to the sides (best of three tries).

name: Rock, paper and scissors icons
note: The three picks for the in-race rock-paper-scissors timer at the top right of the screen: an orange-red stone, a blue sheet of paper with a folded corner, and scissors with green handles. Checked at 64 and 128 px on dark and light backgrounds: all three read clearly, with clean transparent edges. They are simpler than the racer art on purpose (icons have to read small) but keep its bold outlines and glossy colours. Innocent, 2026-11-04: kept for now; the set may still change.

name: Cliff Temple (landmark)
note: The white cliff temple from the Cliff Temple stage art, as one compact model to stand beside the road: just the building on a flat-bottomed rock base, with no cliff, trees or flags (those come from code and the sky backdrop). White walls, a maroon band with gold discs, crimson roofs with gold edges, and two golden pagoda tops that stand out from a distance. Checked that front, side and back show the same building; the back mirrors the front.

name: Cliff Temple sky backdrop
note: A wide 360-degree sky for the Cliff Temple track: blue sky, big clouds, distant green cliffs and a sea of clouds, with no temple (that is a separate 3D model). It wraps around the track behind the scenery, and the bottom fades to pale blue for the code-built cloud sea to meet. Checked: the right edge joins the left with no visible line (Seam check), the horizon sits a little below the middle, no road, people or text.

name: Mirror Flat sky and mountains
note: A wide 360-degree sky for the Mirror Flat track: blue sky, peach-lit clouds and the pink and tan mountain range all the way around. The mountains stop at a clean straight horizon; below it is a plain band, because the mirror ground is built in code. Checked: seamless wrap (Seam check), horizon a little below the middle, no road, signs, people or text.

name: Cliff Temple road surface
note: The Cliff Temple road from straight above: slate-grey asphalt with small grains, repeating along the road (lane lines are drawn by the game). Tiles with no seams. Claude's review: a little darker and more purple than the stage road, and up close the grains read a bit like stars; a colour tint in the game can fix both.

name: Mirror Flat road surface
note: The Mirror Flat road from straight above: polished slate-lavender with a soft brushed shine and tiny sparkles, darker than the white mirror ground so the road stands out (glowing lane lines and boost pads are drawn by the game). Tiles with no seams. The game rotates it so the shine runs along the road rather than reading as rain.

name: Cliff Temple rock wall
note: Rock for the code-built cliffs of Cliff Temple: rounded tan-grey slabs with dark cracks and bright green moss, in the comic-book style of the stage art. Tiles cleanly, but the repeat is visible in the 3×3 view, so the cliffs use it at a large size. A little warmer than the greyer stage cliffs; a tint can match it.

name: Title screen art
note: The picture behind the title screen: all four first-game racers race along a glowing golden sky track toward the cliff temple (Cloud Dragon on his cloud, Spiral on his hover pod, Pink Puff flying on all fours, Centaur Bull galloping). The top of the sky is clear for the logo. Checked each racer against the approved art. Two notes: Spiral has purple hair here (his race art) while his front drawing has black hair, so say which is right; and a faint blur sits by Centaur Bull's front fist where an extra tail was painted out. Approved by Innocent; Spiral's hair is BLACK (his decision), so Spiral's hair in this picture was recoloured to black (2026-11-04).

name: Logo
note: The game's name as a comic-book wordmark on three lines (RACE ON / YOUR OWN / POWER): glossy yellow-to-orange letters, thick black outline, white outer edge, speed streaks and two small clouds, on a see-through background. Spelling checked letter by letter; readable at 600 and 240 px wide.
